decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 6th Energy Store (ES) 6th Control Electronics Unit (PU-CE) 5th MGU-K All listed Power Unit elements were replaced without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during parc fermé.
offence: Breaches of Article B8.2.2 (read in conjunction with B8.2.3), B3.5.3 and B3.5.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: As parts were replaced under parc ferme conditions without the approval of the Technical Delegate a pit lane start is mandated in accordance with Article B3.5.3.a.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 14 Pu Elements Changed During Parc Ferme
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
